contents.contents: Treatise on the liturgy ( Nubdhah fī al-quddās al-ilāhī ), fol. 2v-22r; excerpt on a controversy within the Armenian Catholic Church, fol. 22v-27r; Tabriʼat ṭaqs al-Kaldān min tuhmat al-Qass Bayjān , fol. 32r-53r; Bar Malkon's treatise Risālat al-bayān ʻan qidam al-īmān wa-iqʻād al-iʻtiqād ʻalá suddat al-sadād , fol. 56v-72v; agreement between Atanāʼsiyús I and the bishops of Tikrīt and St. Matthew in 940 AG (629 CE), fol. 73r-76v; excerpts from Míkāʼyel I's history Maktbānút zabne , translated from Syriac, fol. 77r-84r; autobiography of Yoḥanān VIII, translated from Syriac, fol. 85v-98v; ʻAbd al-Jalīl Kharfūsh's poem Lisān al-ṭarab fī yūbīl al-dhahab , fol. 99rv; Ottoman imperial decrees, fol. 101r-110v; treatise on asthenia, fol. 111r-115r; treatise on diabetes, fol. 115v-118v; correspondence of Amanton and Yawsep VI, fol. 119r-124r; Ḥillat al-maḥrūmīn al-wāridah min Baghdād , fol. 124v-125r
contents.notes: Various historical excerpts throughout. Excerpt on the Armenian Catholic Church dated 1888-1889 CE; Ottoman imperial decrees dated 1255-1293 AH (1839-1876 CE); correspondence of Amanton and Yawsep VI dated 1860 CE. Tabriʼat ṭaqs al-Kaldān is a refutation of Paul Bedjan; Ottoman imperial decrees include Edict of Gülhane and Ottoman Reform Edict of 1856 CE; Ḥillat al-maḥrūmīn is a satirical response to the controversy between Amanton and Yawsep VI. All texts in Arabic with some portions in Syriac
